name: Fireworks
summary: Fireworks AI is an inference platform for open and customized models. It offers serverless per-token APIs, on-demand GPU deployments billed per second, managed fine-tuning and a serverless training API for reinforcement learning. Its focus is on companies that tune models for their own workloads.
facts: Per-token billing (input, output, cached) with prepaid credits
H100 $8/h, B200 $13/h, B300 $15/h, billed per second
LoRA SFT from $0.50 to $10 per 1M training tokens by model size
Serverless pay-per-token RL/training, no idle cost
goodFor: RL and post-training without managing GPUs
watchOut: On-demand GPU rates are higher than raw GPU clouds
